event_data.context: PR #34 at signed ad7581a adds a database-local monotonic UUIDv7 allocator, preserves existing PostgreSQL IDs, and proves same-millisecond checkpoint resume across two independent pools. The exact full local gate passed 107 tests. The prototype's real PostgreSQL 17.11 and 18.6 suites passed. Awaiting exact App approval and CI.
